question:
Select the appropriate synonym of the given word.

Diligent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Hardworking**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Diligent"** refers to showing steady, earnest, and energetic effort in one's work or duties. (परिश्रमी)

 
 
• **Example:** She was diligent in her studies, ensuring she understood every topic thoroughly.
 
 
 
• **"Hardworking"** means putting in a lot of effort and perseverance to achieve goals. (मेहनती)
 
 
• **Example:** The hardworking farmer rose early every day to tend to his crops.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Diligent'** is **'Hardworking'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Hardworking**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lazy** (आलसी): Unwilling to work or use energy.

 
 
• **Example:** He avoided his tasks because he was feeling lazy that day.
 
 
 
• **Careless** (लापरवाह): Showing a lack of attention or concern.
 
 
• **Example:** The careless driver caused a minor accident by running a red light.
 
 
 
• **Unreliable** (अविश्वसनीय): Not dependable or trustworthy.
 
 
• **Example:** The unreliable weather forecast made it hard to plan the picnic.
 
 

39:T78b,

The correct answer is** option 1.**
